Class ProtoWire

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.serde.protobuf.wire.ProtoWire
@Internal public final class ProtoWire extends Object
Protocol Buffers wire type constants and the tag/zig-zag arithmetic shared by the reader and the writer.
Since:
3.2
